deadlines.dateText: Depending on the Bachelor's degree held, the procedure for verifying admission requirements as well as the relevant deadlines vary. Information on the different procedures and the applicable deadlines can be found on the [programme’s website](https://www.uni-kiel.de/en/tf/study/msc-eie#c206385), in the section "How do I apply for admission to the Master's degree programme in E&IE and how do I enrol?"
